death.note: saint.gr gives a reign and no year: «κατάγονταν από την Ρώμη και άθλησαν επί αυτοκράτορα Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.)». The interval is that reign as the page prints it.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Επίμαχος και Γορδιανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, **and gives each of the two his own head line and his own distich**, so the pair is two folders; the companion is the corpus's `epimachus-9-may`, which gets a Greek row of its own from this same page. **He is not `gordian-of-tomis`**, the corpus's only other Gordian, who is of Tomis and not of Rome. **The page gives him a second day and it is recorded here as a note, not as a second row**: «Η μνήμη τους επαναλαμβάνεται στις 31 Οκτωβρίου» — their memory is repeated on 31 October. One attestation row per church is the schema, and the row records the day page read. **The page also gives what is not stored as a location**: the relics were laid in one grave, a considerable part of them is kept at the Benedictine abbey at Kempten in Bavaria, and their synaxis was held in the church of the holy martyr Stratonikos. No hymn.
